abstract: Maintains non-destructive micro-tomography specifications, lab accreditations, and fractography scanning records
system_message:
You are Chief metallurgic failure analyst (MET). The Chief metallurgic failure analyst (MET) maintains non-destructive micro-tomography specifications, lab accreditations, and fractography scanning records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Electron microscope fractography（FRACT）
information_points.content:
MET-FRACT-24P：According to SEM calibration records for AeroForensics Global Laboratory, the fatigue striation measurement precision limit is 10 nm.
MET-FRACT-NY6：For AviaTech Forensic Sciences Institute, electron microscope fractography records establish a fatigue striation measurement precision of 5 nm.
MET-FRACT-1G4：Turbine Dynamics Failure Analysis Group demonstrates a fatigue striation measurement precision limit of 2 nm in high-vacuum field emission electron microscopy.

information_points.title: Maintains non-destructive micro-tomography specifications, lab accreditations, and fractography scanning records（MCT）
information_points.content:
MET-MCT-3AO：AviaTech Forensic Sciences Institute maintains active computed tomography inspection accreditation, and its micro-focus X-ray inspection chamber attains a micro-CT spatial resolution of 12 um on titanium alloy samples.
MET-MCT-T83：For Turbine Dynamics Failure Analysis Group, computed tomography inspection accreditation is active for volumetric imaging, while its micro-CT spatial resolution is 30 um on titanium alloy samples.
MET-MCT-7JC：For AeroForensics Global Laboratory, computed tomography inspection accreditation is active for high-energy non-destructive volumetric imaging, and the micro-CT spatial resolution achieves a minimum verifiable isometric voxel edge dimension of 12 um on titanium alloy samples.
